title: probe seam and litmus
description: User story under REQ-175 for DEFINE step 3 PR 7 (spec section 4 row 'D6 scans and the injectable probe runner' and section 11.6). computeReadiness(tree, { probeRunner }) accepts an injectable runner where probeRunner = ({ reqId, tree }) => findings[], default null; injected findings land as probe-ledger entries in the result and count toward consistency:probeCount. src/define/probe-runner.js is added as the seam only; no shipped runner (no LLM in rcf-lite; the harness is the runner through ledger probes add). With no probeRunner the result equals the 0.29.0 result on the same fixture. --litmus <n> on readiness and freeze requires at least n distinct litmus readings at the current hash, read from probe-ledger entries with finding beginning litmus:<reader>: and a hash matching tree.currentTreeHash; one reader exits 4 naming the shortfall. --litmus-attested remains the default attestation path. No process is spawned and no network call is made at runtime; the harness is the runner.
iWant: an injectable probeRunner seam on computeReadiness and a --litmus <n> flag on readiness and freeze that counts recorded litmus probe entries at the current tree hash
soThat: the harness can land fresh-context readings through the probe ledger and rcf-lite exits 4 until n distinct readers have attested at the current hash, without rcf-lite itself calling an LLM or spawning a process

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] given a probeRunner returning two findings for REQ-003, when computeReadiness runs, then both appear as open probe entries in the result and consistency:probeCount fails.
[happy] given no probeRunner, when computeReadiness runs, then the result equals the 0.29.0 result on the same fixture.
[happy] given two probe entries litmus:<reader>: at the current hash from distinct readers, when readiness --litmus 2 runs, then it passes the litmus requirement.
[failure] given one reader, when readiness --litmus 2 runs, then it exits 4 naming the shortfall.
[must-not] given --litmus, when readiness runs, then no process is spawned and no network call is made.
